item.title: Ex-NYPD cadet raped girl, 17, in Brooklyn after meeting on dating app: D.A.
item.description: A former NYPD Police Academy cadet was arrested Tuesday for deceiving a 17-year-old girl about his age and then raping her in Brooklyn, according to Brooklyn District Attorney Eric Gonzalez.

item.title: Man, 75, stabbed to death by neighbor outside his Astoria, Queens, apartment
item.description: George Dourdounas's lifeless body was found inside the 33rd St. building where he lived near 28th Ave. in Astoria around 1:40 p.m., police said.

item.title: Death of ‘Deadliest Catch’ Todd Meadows under investigation
item.description: The U.S. Coast Guard is investigating the death of "Deadliest Catch" fisherman Todd Meadows, who died after falling from a ship in Alaska last week.

item.title: Ivana Trump’s Upper East Side home sells for $14M: report
item.description: Ivana Trump's Upper East Side home reportedly sold for $14M after more than three years on the market. The original asking price was $26 million.

item.title: St. John’s overcomes second-half deficit to beat Georgetown, move into tie atop Big East
item.description: St. John’s is one win away from at least a share of the Big East regular season championship.

item.title: Knicks complete season sweep of Raptors behind improved defense in runaway victory
item.description: The Raptors had nothing for a Knicks team they could see in the first round of the playoffs.

item.description: The Nets didn’t get a chance to exhale in South Florida.
